# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Past-tense completed action naming a specific artifact; attention on what happened, actual and concrete.
Past-tense measurement of a specific metric; settled fact, particular data point.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock

observations.why: Past-tense identification of a named integration as causal factor; actual event, specific artifact.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Declarative statement of fact supplying outcome information; no influence attempt on an audience is performed.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Supplies a measured metric as fact; informational control of the data, but no influence tactic directed at a listener.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Asserts a causal claim that controls the framing of what mattered; informational without a directed influence attempt.
The verb 'shipped' frames the widget as a delivered accomplishment, appealing to achievement as the good.
Superlative framing of velocity as a personal-best benchmark appeals to both achievement standing and demonstrated mastery.
Naming the integration as the decisive capability that unlocked progress appeals to mastery and craft quality.
The Zephyr integration is spoken of AS a key that unlocks — a thing functioning as another thing, not mere vividness.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Plain declarative reporting of a completed achievement; settled satisfaction, no heightened arousal markers.
Superlative marks pride but delivery is measured factual reporting — positive valence at low arousal.
Evaluative phrase signals satisfaction with an outcome, delivered in a settled explanatory register.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion of a completed fact; no ratification language or operational rule to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Plain factual assertion stated with confidence but moveable with evidence; no permanence or identity language.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Asserted causal claim ready to defend but open to challenge; no ratification or bedrock language present.

payload.rationale: This document is a sprint retro (dated 2026-08-23) that directly overlaps the prior Sprint 4 retro (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322, 2026-03-22) — same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr integration as key unlock. I expanded the Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and its four child positions (anti-pattern, product category, target market, pricing) because the async decision widget is the product embodiment of that narrative and the passes need the full positioning context to bind or extend. I included the Zephyr integration position, the velocity observation, the thesis-proven positions, and both style observations so the passes can recognize this as a later retro touching the same claims and style patterns. I did not expand parent areas like Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture or KPIsSuccess because they appeared only as categorization pointers without standalone expandable content in this perspective.

positions.name: Sprint4OutcomeAttribution
positions.frame: what does the team credit for this sprint's delivered outcome and the velocity that produced it?
positions.why: All three expressions read as one causal-report arc: a shipped artifact (src-1), a quantified outcome (src-2), and the named cause behind that outcome (src-3). The directional reads align tightly — all past/realis/concrete, informational in power, calm-positive in affect, and self-enhancement/competence in value — with src-3 supplying the causal attribution ('key unlock') that the other two describe the effects of. Register shifts slightly from matter-of-fact (src-1, src-2) to technical/metaphor (src-3, 'unlock'), but this is the same speaker moving from result to explanation within one continuous account, not a break in the read.

placements.why: The shipped async decision widget is the concrete product embodiment of the consensus-capture insight — a mechanism that intercepts and records decisions at the moment of consensus rather than letting them evaporate into scroll-back. Shipping this artifact is evidence the existing narrative is now realized in product, not a distinct theme in its own right.

placements.title: Velocity follows friction removal, not raw effort
placements.frame: When the team reports a change in delivery pace, what specific integration or dependency is credited for it, and what platform friction did that dependency eliminate?
placements.why: Tina's causal attribution — 23-point velocity, highest this quarter, credited to the Zephyr integration enabling cross-platform embedding without separate plugins — names a subject future sprint retros will keep feeding: which integration removed which friction and what pace resulted. This is a recurring execution-causality story, not a one-time fact. None of the three existing leaves (anti-Slack product positioning, consensus-capture product mechanism, decisions-evaporate problem framing) cover the team's internal delivery-velocity/technical-dependency narrative, so nothing existing plausibly holds it. Per the grain rule, the velocity figure (src-2) is evidence for this theme rather than a leaf of its own; it is bundled with the integration claim (src-3) that it directly supports.
